title: Signals batch envelope (schema_version 1)
description: The body of `POST /v1/events` as `application/json`. For `application/x-ndjson` the first line is this object without `events` and every following non-empty line is one event. Limits that JSON Schema cannot express: the body is at most 1 MB (1,048,576 bytes) after decompression and each event is at most 16 KB (16,384 bytes) serialised; collectors answer 413 for the body limit and reject single events with `too_large`. Whole-batch precedence is decoded body size, event count, then JSON/envelope validity; JSON parsing is needed to determine its count, while NDJSON counts non-empty event lines first.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version. Additive changes keep it; a breaking change bumps it and collectors accept the previous version for twelve months.

sent_at.description: SDK clock at send time (RFC 3339); SDKs emit YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ. Collectors must accept the canonical form and may reject other RFC 3339 forms. The reference mock rejects leap seconds as malformed_envelope. The collector derives clock skew as `received_at - sent_at`.

dropped.description: Events discarded by the SDK since its last successful flush (queue overflow). Defaults to 0 when omitted.

events.description: Event objects, in emission order. At most 1000 per batch; collectors answer 413 above that.

source.description: The emitting SDK and process. All strings must be non-empty after trimming; SDKs trim before sending. `hostname` is optional; every other key is required.

sdk.description: SDK identifier: `node`, `python`, or another identifier registered later.

server_name.description: MCP server info name when available, else the host package / distribution name when the SDK can determine it, else the SDK's own name. `SIGNALS_SERVICE_NAME` overrides. A blank (empty or whitespace-only) or non-string value at any layer is treated as absent and the fallback chain continues.

server_version.description: MCP server info version when available, else the host package / distribution version when the SDK can determine it, else `0.0.0`. `SIGNALS_SERVICE_VERSION` overrides. A blank (empty or whitespace-only) or non-string value at any layer is treated as absent and the fallback chain continues.

hostname.description: Optional. When present, a string non-empty after trimming of at most 256 code points; an SDK omits the key instead of sending a blank value and truncates a longer hostname to 256.
